text_block_list.text:
On the morning after the break, I spotted 
Mayano Top Gun and called out to her, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no~~!! Close your eyes!! Don't 
look this waaaay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh…… I was practicing my makeup 
yesterday, and before I knew it, it was 
already morning……!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
There are faint dark circles under your 
eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I only want Trainer-chan to see my 
cute side~~~!

It seemed Mayano Top Gun wasn't able to 
get proper rest on her day off...
